title: Market strip: uniform tiles; S&P 500 taken from the CNN payload
changes: S&P 500, Bitcoin and Fear & Greed share one tile layout: label, change or rating, large value and a bottom bar (direction colour, or the 0 to 100 gauge with a pin)
The S&P 500 value and daily change now come from the same CNN request as Fear & Greed (market_momentum_sp500), since Yahoo Finance was unreachable from the browser; Yahoo stays as a fallback
The Fear & Greed sparkline was removed for visual consistency; CNN data is refreshed every ten minutes, Bitcoin every two
